request_payload.title: Germline KRAS and BRAF mutations in cardio-facio-cutaneous syndrome.

mentions.sentence: In 43 individuals with CFC, we identified two heterozygous KRAS mutations in three individuals and eight BRAF mutations in 16 individuals, suggesting that dysregulation of the RAS-RAF-ERK pathway is a common molecular basis for the three related disorders.
